items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Yeah, right on Tash Street, Nell J's here.

ctx.x: Yeah, on the side of the river, on Tash. I mean down near the ferry boat here? No. Or up the river farther? No.
Oh, right on Tash, over the river. Yeah. Yeah, right on Tash Street, Nell J's here. Yeah. Right down Tash Street there.
I know, I know where Newton is and I know where the theaters and all are.
